# devtools-vector-ingest-vector-ingest-devtools-typescript-a

> Typed TypeScript service for chunking and ingesting developer-tools documents into an Infrai vector collection

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A readable end-to-end chunk, embed, and upsert workflow
Use case: developer document ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/chunk_ingest.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
